pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Same alphanumeric labeling convention (D-n) reused independently by two different documents -- a clean illustration of the 'same notation insufficient alone' rule.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: group_evidence is SHARED-NOTATION on 'D-1..D-4', but full-row check shows this is coincidental: family A's D-1..D-4 are the four defects found by an independent reviewer in a specific book chapter set (GN-38, S1225), while family B's D-1..D-4 is one axis of its own D/I/M/N/S (Defects/Insights/Methodology/Next-steps/Summary) rubric over eleven unrelated experiments; B's full rows contain no mention of GN-38 or of A's specific D-1..D-4 defects, and A's rows contain no mention of the eleven-experiment synthesis.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row in B explicitly listing the GN-38 book-review defects as part of its own D-1..D-4 category, or a row in A citing the eleven-experiments synthesis.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Model uncertainty dominates sampling uncertainty by a wide margin, and the programme's instruments were calibrated the wrong way round. ... exactly one non-vacuous result [across 150,000 randomized trials]. ... Seven of the eleven experiments used no randomization at all and produced more.
rationale_evidence.statement: Statistical governing finding: model uncertainty dominates sampling uncertainty by a wide margin and the programme's instruments were calibrated the wrong way round -- across 150,000 randomized trials the suite produced exactly one non-vacuous result (the central factivity theorem, established by just two worlds), while seven of eleven experiments used no randomization at all and produced more.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Randomized testing is the wrong instrument for semantic discrimination. ... Use adversarial deterministic cases, exhaustive enumeration over small structured spaces, and witnesses -- the three that actually produced results here.
rationale_evidence.statement: Randomized testing cannot tell whether two epistemic conditions are the same condition; it measures how often a chosen generator produces a situation. The three instruments that actually produced results across the eleven experiments were adversarial deterministic cases (2 worlds -> the factivity theorem), exhaustive enumeration over small structured spaces (1,620,000 exhaustive assignments -> the Zero chain), and witnesses (2^11 exhaustive facet subsets -> the two minimal typing sets).

rationale_evidence.anchor: I-2. Specification defects hide until adversarially attacked. Sat_content is not a function on contradictory states; the reason vocabulary was incomplete in 2 of 32 cells; operational evaluation is not well-founded. ... Specification-before-implementation is not a preference here; it is the only reason these were found.
rationale_evidence.statement: I-2: three specification defects (Sat_content not a function on contradictory states, the reason vocabulary incomplete in 2 of 32 cells, operational evaluation not well-founded) were invisible until a case was built to adversarially break them and would have been concealed by implementation -- specification-before-implementation is the only reason they were found here.

rationale_evidence.anchor: I-3. Over-specification is as dangerous as under-specification. The typed facet vocabulary has 37 of 41 distinctions doing no work on the suite that motivated it. ... A vocabulary large enough to separate anything separates nothing.
rationale_evidence.statement: I-3: over-specification is as dangerous as under-specification -- the typed facet vocabulary has 37 of 41 distinctions doing no work on the motivating suite; each has a provenance but none has evidence; a vocabulary large enough to separate anything separates nothing.

## Rationale
Analysis: Statistical governing finding: model uncertainty dominates sampling uncertainty by a wide margin and the programme's instruments were calibrated the wrong way round -- across 150,000 randomized trials the suite produced exactly one non-vacuous result (the central factivity theorem, established by just two worlds), while seven of eleven experiments used no randomization at all and produced more. [S2436] States as a principle: Randomized testing cannot tell whether two epistemic conditions are the same condition; it measures how often a chosen generator produces a situation. The three instruments that actually produced results across the eleven experiments were adversarial deterministic cases (2 worlds -> the factivity theorem), exhaustive enumeration over small structured spaces (1,620,000 exhaustive assignments -> the Zero chain), and witnesses (2^11 exhaustive facet subsets -> the two minimal typing sets). [S2436] Argues that I-2: three specification defects (Sat_content not a function on contradictory states, the reason vocabulary incomplete in 2 of 32 cells, operational evaluation not well-founded) were invisible until a case was built to adversarially break them and would have been concealed by implementation -- specification-before-implementation is the only reason they were found here. [S2436] Argues that I-3: over-specification is as dangerous as under-specification -- the typed facet vocabulary has 37 of 41 distinctions doing no work on the motivating suite; each has a provenance but none has evidence; a vocabulary large enough to separate anything separates nothing.
